official_sources.title: Planning Data documentation and API reference

verified_claims: The entity search endpoint supports json, html and geojson extensions.
A specific entity can be requested by numeric entity identifier.
Entity search supports entry-date matching with match, before and since semantics.
Coordinate searches require latitude and longitude together.
Coordinate and WKT geometry searches use WGS84 EPSG:4326.
Geometry filters support entity, reference, curie and raw WKT inputs.
Spatial relations include within, equals, disjoint, intersects, touches, contains, covers, coveredby, overlaps and crosses.
Multiple dataset parameters can be combined in one query.
UPRN search uses q and is described as more precise than coordinate search for registered properties.
Responses can include name, dataset, start-date, geometry and point fields.
Field and exclude_field filters control response projection, with field taking precedence.
Large result sets use limit and offset and expose next, previous, first and last links.
The API has no portfolio batch endpoint and recommends polite per-property request pacing.
Bulk CSV, JSON, GeoJSON and Parquet downloads provide stable local-analysis snapshots.
Live API and bulk snapshot provenance must not be treated as interchangeable.
Coverage varies and absence of results is not proof that no planning constraint exists.
The API is beta and response-contract drift must remain fail-closed.
